pick.headline: Gdansk Agreement signed with the strikers
pick.fbis: The Eastern Europe Daily Report of September 2, 1980, carried Gdansk radio's recording of the August 30 shipyard meeting between Jagielski's government commission and Walesa's strike committee, with Andrzej Gwiazda reading the agreed terms for new self-governing trade unions.

alternates.headline: Last Russian troops leave Germany
alternates.fbis: The Central Eurasia Daily Report of August 31, 1994, carried an ITAR-TASS press review on the farewell ceremony for the last Russian troops leaving Germany, quoting Yeltsin that "an epoch of enmity" was ending, and KRASNAYA ZVEZDA on 338,000 troops withdrawn.
